data.title: Diverse Fitness and Sports Activities Kick Off Across Yanbu Industrial City
data.content:
Yanbu, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu has announced a series of weekly sports programs in Yanbu Industrial City, running from November 21 to 26, to promote sports participation and encourage community members to adopt a healthy, active lifestyle.
    Featuring seven activities—mat Pilates, gym-based physical conditioning, circuit training, plyometrics, swimming fundamentals, aero-fitness, and kickboxing—the programs extend the commission's efforts to diversify community sports offerings, enhance public health, and improve overall quality of life in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
